research.qualityIntro: Evaluate materials using the documents for the actual product and batch. Availability of a report is shown explicitly; missing reports are not presented as verified results.
research.qualityIdentityBody: Check the chemical identity, composition, quantity and unit against the original specification. Analytical purity, material content and identity are different measurements.
research.qualityReportsBody: A report should identify the batch, laboratory, test method, result, unit and date. Accreditation or supplier quality claims are published only when their supporting evidence has been approved.
research.qualityHandlingBody: Use the conditions in the product-specific documentation. Do not assume that the same storage or preparation conditions apply to every material.
research.aboutIntro: AverianLabs provides a catalogue and ordering tools for laboratory research materials. Product documentation and clear purchasing information help customers evaluate materials for their work.
research.aboutEvidenceBody: We distinguish published documentation from information awaiting review. Contact support if a specification or report you need is unavailable.
research.aboutSupportBody: Ask about product identity, batch documentation, quantities and purchase availability. Quotes are handled separately from direct orders.
research.labIntro: Read the original report for the selected batch. The methods below describe different analytical questions and do not imply that every product has undergone every test.
research.labPurityBody: HPLC reports describe a result under a specified analytical method. Chromatographic purity should not be treated as a measurement of the total amount of material in a container.
research.labIdentityBody: Mass spectrometry can provide molecular-mass evidence. A sequence or composition claim needs the appropriate supporting analysis and specification; mass alone is not a complete sequence determination.
research.labEndotoxinBody: Endotoxin, sterility and other test results are shown only when applicable and supported by the report. Retain the units used in the original result, such as EU/mg.
research.coaIntro: Find published documents for a product or batch. A document link is not a blanket PASS designation; assess the methods and results in the original report.
research.faqUseQuestion: What are these materials intended for?
research.faqUseAnswer: These materials are for laboratory research. Product-specific documentation describes identity, composition and handling; the catalogue does not provide instructions for human or veterinary administration.
research.faqDocumentsQuestion: Where can I find batch documents?
research.faqDocumentsAnswer: Open Batch documents or the documents section on the product page. If a report is unavailable, contact us before ordering.
research.faqShippingQuestion: Where can I place a direct order?
research.faqShippingAnswer: Direct checkout currently supports delivery to Finland. Other destinations and business-specific tax arrangements require a quote.
research.faqQuoteQuestion: How do I request a quote?
research.faqQuoteAnswer: Submit the quote form with your email and requirements. A receipt is displayed after your request has been recorded.

research.privacyIntro: This notice describes the storefront’s personal data processing. For questions about your information, contact the seller using the details below.
research.privacyDataBody: Accounts store your email, name and a password hash or a connected sign-in identity. Orders store contact details, addresses, purchased items and payment references. Quote requests and support messages store the details you submit. These records support purchasing, account access and customer service.
research.privacyAnalyticsBody: Optional analytics load only after you accept them. You can withdraw consent using Cookie settings in the footer. Private account and checkout pages are excluded from analytics. If you use the assistant, your submitted messages are processed by the configured AI provider; saved conversation memory requires its separate consent setting.
research.privacyBasisBody: Order processing relies on performance of a contract and accounting records on applicable legal obligations. Optional analytics and saved assistant memory rely on consent. Security and support processing must be documented under the appropriate legal basis. Configured payment, email, hosting, storage and AI providers process the data needed to provide their services. The seller must make its approved provider list and transfer safeguards available before accepting orders.
research.privacyRightsBody: You may request access, correction, erasure, restriction or portability of your personal data and object where applicable. Account settings provide an export and deletion request. You may also contact Finland’s Office of the Data Protection Ombudsman (tietosuoja.fi). The EU General Data Protection Regulation and Finland’s Data Protection Act (1050/2018) apply.
research.privacyRetentionBody: Deleting an account disables access and removes sign-in credentials and private account content immediately. This cannot be undone. Purchase records and other records subject to legal retention are retained separately. The seller must approve and publish the retention periods for accounting, support, logs, backups and external providers before launch.
research.cookiesIntro: Essential browser storage supports sign-in, your cart, checkout progress, saved products and your consent choices. Optional analytics require your consent.
research.cookiesEssentialBody: The age confirmation and cookie choice are stored for up to one year. The sign-in session lasts up to 30 days. Cart, checkout progress, saved products and comparisons use browser local storage until you clear them. Payment providers may use storage required to process your payment.
research.cookiesAnalyticsBody: When configured, PostHog and Vercel Analytics or Speed Insights load after you accept optional analytics. PostHog session recording and automatic interaction capture are disabled. Analytics exclude private account and checkout routes, and page URLs omit query parameters.
research.cookiesChoiceBody: Use Cookie settings in the footer to reopen the choice. Selecting essential only stops optional analytics collection. You can also clear saved cart, checkout and consent information through your browser settings.
research.termsIntro: These purchasing terms describe the currently supported storefront. Obtain the seller’s registered details and approved commercial terms before placing an order.
research.termsUseBody: Materials are intended for laboratory research. They are not supplied for human or veterinary administration. Review the product-specific specification, handling information and original batch reports before deciding whether a material is suitable for your research.
research.termsPriceBody: Direct checkout currently supports delivery to Finland in euros. Displayed product and delivery prices include Finnish VAT at 25.5%. Checkout shows the final total before payment. Entering a VAT ID does not enable reverse charge or remove VAT. Other destinations and tax arrangements require a separate quote.
research.termsAvailabilityBody: Direct purchase requires an approved product specification, an assigned released batch, a published report and available stock. Stock is reserved temporarily during payment. An order is shown as paid only after the payment provider confirms it. A late payment that cannot be fulfilled automatically is held for review.
research.termsDeliveryBody: Available delivery methods, charges and estimates appear at checkout. Dispatch timing, handling conditions and return arrangements must be confirmed for the order. Contact support with the order number to report damage, an incorrect item or a return request. Statutory rights remain unaffected.
research.disclaimerIntro: Catalogue information supports the evaluation and purchase of laboratory materials.
research.disclaimerUseBody: The catalogue and concentration calculator do not provide medical advice, treatment recommendations or administration instructions. Product documentation does not establish suitability for human or veterinary use.
research.disclaimerEvidenceBody: Chromatographic purity, identity and material content are different measurements. Assess the original test method, result, units and batch identity. A document link does not imply that every test has passed or that every product has been tested in the same way.
research.shippingIntro: Direct checkout currently supports Finland. Contact us for other destinations and purchasing arrangements.
research.shippingRatesBody: Checkout calculates delivery using the selected method. Delivery is free when the product subtotal is at least €150. Displayed delivery prices include VAT. Estimates depend on the carrier and destination.
research.shippingHandlingBody: Use the product-specific handling documents for storage requirements. Contact support if your work requires special transport conditions or a confirmed dispatch date.
research.shippingReturnsBody: Contact support with your order number before sending an item back. Include the item, batch and the reason for your request. Report damage or a mismatch with the order as soon as you can.
